description:
As a registered user, I want to log in to the application using my email address and password so that I can access my personal dashboard.

The login page must include:
- An email address input field
- A password input field (characters must be masked)
- A 'Remember Me' checkbox
- A 'Forgot Password' link that navigates to the password reset flow
- A 'Login' submit button

Authentication behaviour:
- Validate that the email follows standard email format (e.g., user@example.com)
- Password must be at least 8 characters
- Lock the account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts
- Display appropriate error messages for invalid credentials without revealing which field is wrong
acceptance_criteria: User can log in successfully with a valid registered email and correct password
System displays a generic error message 'Invalid email or password' for wrong credentials
Account is locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts
Locked account displays message: 'Your account has been locked. Contact support to unlock.'
Selecting 'Remember Me' keeps the session active for 30 days via a secure HTTP-only cookie
Session expires automatically after 30 minutes of inactivity when 'Remember Me' is not checked
Password field masks all characters during input
Login page is accessible over HTTPS only
Login works correctly on Chrome, Firefox, and Safari (desktop and mobile)

attachments.content:
Technical Specifications - Login Module

Email validation: RFC 5322 standard
Password constraints: minimum 8 characters, maximum 128 characters
Failed attempt counter: resets to 0 on successful login
Locked account unlock: requires manual intervention by support team
Remember Me: sets a JWT with 30-day expiry in an HTTP-only, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookie
Session token: stored in memory (not localStorage); expires after 30 minutes of inactivity
All authentication endpoints must use TLS 1.2 or higher
Error messages must not reveal whether email exists in the system
Rate limiting: max 10 login requests per minute per IP
